description: Pericolosità idraulica is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by opendata.comune.siena.it. La pericolosità idraulica è la probabilità che un fenomeno di natura alluvionale potenzialmente distruttivo si verifichi in un dato tempo ed in una data area ed è definita in base al tempo di ritorno o al rischio idraulico.Definisce le classi da 1 a 4 di pericolosità idraulica del territorio comunale, ai sensi del D.P.G.R. n. Coverage: IT. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
